notes.title: Grace Online: Major Update V0.8.0.41 - New Adventures & Surprises Await!
notes.content:
[h1]📰 Grace Online - Major Update V0.8.0.41 Brings a Wealth of New Features! 📰[/h1]
Hello, Grace Online adventurers!

We're beyond excited to share the latest news from the realm of Grace Online. The highly anticipated Update V0.8.0.41 has arrived on Steam! This substantial update is one of our most expansive yet, overflowing with fresh content, enhancements, and bug fixes set to drastically elevate your in-game journey.

[h2]📌 The Adventure Unfolds in V0.8.0.41[/h2]
[h3]Embark on Fresh Quests![/h3]
Adventure calls, brave souls! Prepare to step into uncharted lands, cross paths with intriguing characters, and rise to the challenges in our exciting new quests.

[h3]Unearth Powerful New Weapons & Armors![/h3]
Our armory has expanded! With a collection of brand-new weapons and armors, each offering unique capabilities and stats, your perfect battle gear is waiting to be discovered. Are you ready to equip yourself for glory?

[h3]Specialized Weapons and Skills for Each Class![/h3]
Your chosen class is now more distinctive and rewarding than ever. With unique weapons and skills for each class, the time to master your abilities is now. 

[h3]Immerse Yourself in Revamped Animations![/h3]
Experience Grace Online like never before! With 90% of our animations updated, we promise a visually stunning and immersive journey that you'll fall in love with.

[h3]Strategize with the Overhauled Skill System![/h3]
We've enhanced the skill system to provide a more balanced and engaging gameplay experience. Prepare to strategize and make every skill count!

[h3]Optimize with the Updated Character Stats System![/h3]
A fresh layer of strategy awaits! Mages now require Intelligence for their weapons and armor, and we've introduced a dedicated Mana stat. How will you optimize your character?

[h3]Explore UI Improvements & New Crafting Recipes![/h3]
To make your journey smoother, we've finessed the UI and added innovative crafting recipes. It's time to explore and create like never before!

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes & Enhancements[/h2]
Good news! We've addressed the range skills missing issue, and the player collider problem is history. Brace yourself for smarter and more challenging monster encounters.

[h2]🎁 Surprises Await![/h2]
But that's not all, adventurers! We've sprinkled a few surprises in this update. Are you ready to discover them all?

[h2]📢 We Value Your Feedback![/h2]
Your voice shapes the world of Grace Online. We invite you to share your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences after delving into the new update.

We're thrilled for you to immerse yourself in all the fresh features and enhancements that Update V0.8.0.41 brings. See you in the realm!

Best, Deepankar Grace Online Team

notes.title: Major Update V0.8.0.41: New Quests, Weapons, Skills, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Major Update V0.8.0.41 is Live Now - New Quests, Weapons, Skills, and More! 🎉[/h1]
Hello, Grace Online community!

We are thrilled to announce that the much-anticipated Update V0.8.0.41 is finally live on Steam! This is one of our biggest updates yet, jam-packed with a ton of new content, enhancements, and bug fixes that will drastically improve your in-game experience.

[h1]🌟 What's New in V0.8.0.41?[/h1]

[h3][b]New Quests and Adventures Await![/b][/h3] Get ready to embark on exciting new quests that will lead you to unexplored lands and introduce you to intriguing characters. Will you rise to the challenge?

[h3][b]Discover Powerful New Weapons & Armors![/b] [/h3]We've added an array of brand-new weapons and armor, each with unique capabilities and stats. Will you find the perfect gear that aligns with your playing style?

[h3][b]Class-Specific Weapons and Skills![/b][/h3] Each class now boasts its unique weapons and skills, making your chosen class feel more distinct and rewarding. Time to master your class!

[h3][b]Revamped Animations![/b][/h3] We've updated 90% of the animations to provide a more immersive and visually pleasing experience. You'll love the fresh look and feel!

[h3][b]Overhauled Skill System![/b] [/h3]The skill system has been given a major overhaul to provide a more balanced and engaging gameplay experience. Time to strategize and make every skill count!

[h3][b]Updated Character Stats System![/b] [/h3]Weapons and armor for mages will now require Intelligence instead of Strength, introducing a new layer of strategy. A dedicated stat for Mana has also been added. Ready to optimize your character?

[h3][b]UI Improvements & New Crafting Recipes![/b] [/h3]To make your experience even smoother, we've done some UI tweaks and added new crafting recipes. Explore and create like never before!

[h1]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Enhancements[/h1]
[h3]
[b]Fixed Range Skills Missing Issue[/b][/h3] We've heard your feedback, and we're happy to report that the issue with range skills missing has been fixed. Aim and shoot with confidence!

[h3][b]Fixed Player Collider Issue[/b][/h3] You reported it, we fixed it! The player collider issue is now a thing of the past.

[h3][b]Monsters AI Updated[/b][/h3] Our monsters have gotten smarter! Brace yourself for more challenging and unpredictable encounters.

[h1]🎁 Surprises Await![/h1]
We're not stopping here, adventurers! We've secretly added a few surprises in this update. Can you discover them all?

[h1]🙏 Your Feedback Matters![/h1]
Your feedback is crucial in making Grace Online the best it can be. Please don't hesitate to share your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences after exploring the new update.

We're incredibly excited for you to jump in and experience all the new features and improvements Update [b]V0.8.0.4[/b]1 has to offer. See you in the game!

Best,
Deepankar
Grace Online Team

notes.title: Update v0.8.0.38 - Referral System, Ranged Skills Overhaul & More!
notes.content:
[h1]Update v0.8.0.38 - Referral System, Ranged Skills Overhaul and More[/h1]

Greetings adventurers,

We are excited to announce the launch of version 0.8.0.38, packed with numerous updates designed to improve your experience in the world of Grace Online. Here's a rundown of the latest changes:

[b]- Referral System:[/b] We've introduced a new Referral System! Invite your friends to join you in your adventures and earn rewards. More the merrier!

[b]- Influencer Program:[/b] Are you an influencer or have a large circle of gamer friends? Reach out to us on our Discord server to learn about our new Influencer Program. Let's grow together!

[b]- Ranged Skills Attack System Overhaul:[/b] Our ranged skills attack system has been overhauled, enhancing combat precision and satisfaction.

[b]- Enhanced Server Stability:[/b] We've made under-the-hood improvements to our servers to ensure smoother gameplay and fewer interruptions.

[b]- Improved Game Balance:[/b] Several adjustments have been made to the game balance to provide a fair and challenging gaming experience.

[b]- Fixes and Improvements:[/b] 
  - Fixed an issue where exploding missile damage wouldn't apply upon explosion. 
  - Corrected an issue with collider bounds size calculation. 
  - Improved the hit registration workflow to work better with MissileDamageEntity.

[b]- Optimized Network Code:[/b] We've optimized our network code to improve overall game performance and reduce latency.

[b]- Upgraded Game Engine:[/b] The game engine has been updated to offer better visuals and smoother gameplay.

Please continue to share your feedback - it's invaluable to us. We're committed to making Grace Online the best game it can be!

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Patch Note v0.8.0.11
notes.content:
Hello Grace Online Players,

We're excited to announce that a new update, version 0.8.0.11, has been released for our Early Access game. This update includes several changes and fixes to improve your gaming experience.

Here are the details of the update:

- Starting area monster balance has been improved to provide a more challenging gameplay experience.
- Weapon damage balance has been adjusted to enhance combat mechanics.
- We've fixed an issue where the monster HP exceeded the maximum limit.
- Crafting item names have been fixed for better clarity.
- We've resolved an issue with quest task counters not working correctly
- Item drop particle effects have been optimized.
- We've fixed an issue with creating and leaving parties.
- Item drops have been updated with new items to enhance your gameplay experience.
- We've added a new weapon, Bero Mace, for you to wield in your battles.
- We've added a new NPC(Kaida) with a weapons and armor shop for all your equipment needs.
- We hope these updates and improvements will enhance your gameplay experience and make your journey through Grace Online even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

If you didn't receive the new update on steam try restarting the steam client.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42794749/21f84c86e024940858b660808b8bdc818cb62ed0.png[/img].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42794749/5eb943982136b14e6b3f0f330207b9dc7eeeb3e5.png[/img]


Happy gaming!

Best regards,
Overlight Dev
